# Copernicus DEM GLO-30

- **Source**: European Space Agency (ESA) / Copernicus Programme
- **URL**: https://spacedata.copernicus.eu/collections/copernicus-digital-elevation-model
- **Licence**: Open Access / Copernicus Sentinel Data Terms
- **Resolution**: 30m Digital Surface Model
- **Use**: Elevation and slope derivation for terrain roughness, water flow, and irrigability ceiling
- **Access Route**: AWS Open Data Registry (`s3://copernicus-dem-30m`) / STAC API
